Frequently Asked Questions

Find the right Ruchi Realty project

Answers to common questions about exploring and comparing our real estate portfolio.

How can I find a Ruchi Realty project in my preferred city?+

Use the city filters on this page to view Ruchi Realty projects in Kolkata, Indore or Bhopal, then open a project to review its location, status, amenities and enquiry options.

What types of Ruchi Realty projects can I compare?+

The portfolio includes residential apartments, plotted developments and commercial properties. Use the property-type filter to narrow the list to the kind of real estate you are considering.

How do I find ready-to-move Ruchi Realty projects?+

Select Ready to Move under the Status filter. The results will show projects currently listed in that category; confirm the latest unit or plot availability with the relevant project team.

Where can I find a project's RERA number?+

Open the relevant project detail page to view its RERA registration number when applicable and available. Buyers should also verify registration details on the official state RERA portal.

How can I get project prices, plans and availability?+

Open a project and submit its enquiry form. The project team will share current pricing, available configurations or plots, floor plans and site-visit options.
